function: Learns user access to LEO satellites, transmit power splitting between two RSMA sub-messages, and receive beamforming to maximize uplink sum rate (p. 1-2).
system: Uplink: U single-antenna ground terminals, L=2 LEO satellites with M=8 antennas each, 780 km altitude, 30 GHz carrier, RSMA; no RIS (p. 2, 4).
method: Hybrid PPO (H-PPO) reinforcement learning on a parameterized MDP; a generative diffusion denoising network replaces the discrete actor; trained by reinforcement (p. 1, 3).
data_channel: Custom simulator: path loss, antenna gains and Rician fading (variance 2), STK 11.6 software; no 3GPP model or public dataset (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training and testing conditions not separated; sum rate swept over power budget 30-38 dBm, noise -98 to -90 dBm and 2-8 terminals (p. 4-5).
baselines: Three learned variants: NOMA-GDM, RSMA-non-GDM and NOMA-non-GDM (RSMA or NOMA, with or without the diffusion actor); no non-learned method (p. 4-5).
metrics: Episode reward (convergence) and sum rate (bps/Hz) versus transmit power budget, noise power and number of terminals (p. 4-5).
complexity: Analytical time complexity O(Emax(...)) in FLOPS over actors, critic and diffusion steps N, plus space complexity; no measured runtime (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "small-scale fading is Rician distribution with variance 2". The channel is a custom simulator with Rician fading and free-space path loss; no 3GPP TR 38.811/38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 5: "Fig. 4(c) compares the sum rate under different terminal numbers". Only sweeps of terminals, power and noise are shown; no model trained in one setting is tested in another, and the network input size depends on U (p. 4).
q3_support: p. 4: "the proposed method separately surpasses NOMA-GDM, RSMA-non-GDM" and NOMA-non-GDM. All three baselines are learned variants (ablation or NOMA version of the same agent); no non-learned baseline is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "the computational complexity becomes" O(Emax(...)) in Eq. (21), with FLOPS per network in Eq. (20) and the space complexity in Eq. (22), Sec. III-D.
q5_support: p. 4: "small-scale fading is Rician distribution with variance 2". Data come from the authors' own simulator; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Included, area 6: the learned agent controls user access, power splitting and receive beamforming of uplink RSMA in LEO links, a joint physical-layer decision, so above_phy does not apply (p. 1-2). Baselines are learned variants only, so q3=0. Complexity analysis in Sec. III-D gives q4=1. PDF title and DOI match on p. 1.
